title: I can't get rid of the react dev version error message.

comments.body:
Hello, 

If you are not using the builded version of instantsearch.js (jsDelivr) then you need to build your project using webpack's ENV plugin: https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/9aa93e0d7ae9843729f158c8deff679eaf8ec7d2/scripts/webpack.config.jsdelivr.babel.js#L29-L35

Then on the command line, when building: `NODE_ENV=production npm run build`
See http://facebook.github.io/react/downloads.html#npm as linked in the url in the error message. A bit tricky for recent users of npm/webpack/browserify I agree.
Thanks @vvo I'll try that and get back :) worth a FAQ entry maybe. (I searched the doc for "production")
This is a NODE_ENV issue and webpack issue, solved by https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/issues/1044#issuecomment-222443662
